notes.title: Patch Notes – Displayed Mac version number updated
notes.notes:
Hi guys,

little update for the Mac version of ‘Harvey’s New Eyes’. There had been some problems with the displayed version number of the game. This often led to communication problems and misunderstandings with our support team, so this is only a little but necessary change to game. 

Best,
Your Daedalic Team

notes.title: Achievement Patch & Trading Cards added
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that today we are releasing a new patch to Harvey’s New Eyes. The patch fixes problems players have been experiencing with the achievements and will be downloaded automatically by the Steamclient.

Additionally we are also releasing 8 new exclusively designed Steam Trading Cards for Harvey’s New Eyes that you can obtain when playing the game. These digital trading cards can be exchanged with other players or traded for game badges and Steam community items.

http://www.daedalic.de/images/Harveys_neue_augeeen.jpg

notes.title: Update 2.0 available: Multilanguage Tool integrated
notes.notes:
Harvey's New Eyes now is updated to version 2.0. All available languages are integrated in our multilanguage tool. You just install your game once and choose the languages you want.
All your old savegames are compatible to this new version. This update provides additional bugfixing and an optimized performance.
